card.name: Space or bracket after hydrochlorothiazide
card.fires_on: The space, comma or opening bracket right after the drug name hydrochlorothiazide (or a similar drug name like losartan potassium), just before a dose number or abbreviation.

modes.label: Space before dose
modes.description: A space or comma after the drug name, with a milligram amount coming next.

modes.label: Bracket after drug name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after the drug name, leading into a dose or HCTZ.

card.plain: It fires on the small gap or bracket right after hydrochlorothiazide, where a dose amount is about to follow.
